summary: Iteration 12 — Team accounts + temporary PIN + forced change-PIN + campaign QR posters + push scaffolding — all four changes verified end-to-end on backend, web, and mobile. Backend pytest test_iteration12_temp_pin_push.py: 11/11 passed (POST /api/users returns temp_pin+invite_sent+must_change_pin=True when send_invite=true without an explicit pin; explicit pin path returns a normal user (no temp_pin, must_change_pin=False); POST /api/users/{id}/invite regenerates a 6-digit temp_pin and flips must_change_pin=True; full temp-PIN flow — login with temp_pin returns must_change_pin=True → change-pin with no current_pin succeeds → subsequent login returns must_change_pin=False → change-pin without current_pin now 400 → same/new duplicate 400 → non-digit/short new_pin 400 → correct current_pin+new_pin 200 → wrong current_pin 400; seeded admin/lead_manager/account_manager/staff all login with must_change_pin=False; POST /api/register-push route exists — 422 on missing body, 500 with placeholder EMERGENT_PUSH_KEY, as documented in the review request). Web (prize-wheel-hub-4.preview.emergentagent.com): lead_manager login → /home (hero, workspace cards, role-based CRM quick actions medicare-search/leads/campaigns/team-pipeline/analytics/import-data, workflow strip, home-signout); open-crm → /crm, open-events → /events, home-signout → /login. account_manager login → /home with My Leads/My Tasks/Meetings/Opportunities/Communications/Call List quick actions (visible in screenshot; note testid lookup returned 0 for some due to timing but visually all rendered). admin login → /home with admin quick actions (Import Data, Enrichment Providers observed; Users & Teams button in header/sidebar). staff login → /dashboard directly (bypasses /home). /crm/users (admin): 'New User' button opens modal with 'Auto-generate a temporary PIN & email an invite' checkbox default-on, saving creates a user and shows invite-result dialog with invite-temp-pin (6 digits, verified: 076444). Row shows 'Invite pending' badge + user-invite-{id} resend button (both confirmed via code + screenshot). Forced PIN change flow — logging in as the freshly-created temp-PIN user redirected to /change-pin; page renders new-pin + confirm-pin ONLY (no current-pin field); on Save the app lands on /home; re-logging in with new PIN goes directly to /home. Campaign QR poster — /crm/campaigns → click a campaign card → 'QR Poster' (open-qr-poster) opens modal with campaign-qr-canvas rendered plus qr-download and qr-print buttons (screenshot confirms QR image visible). Mobile (prize-wheel-hub-4.expo.preview.emergentagent.com, 390x844): AM regression login → My Day tabs (4 stat cards + Today's meetings + Tasks Due + New Leads including prior TEST leads) — no red screen from the push scaffolding in app/_layout.tsx. Fresh temp-PIN user created via API, mobile login with that email+temp_pin routed to /change-pin (new-pin + confirm-pin only, no current-pin), save-PIN then lands on tabs (My Day). No parity issues.

ui_bugs.issue: Nested <button> inside <button>: delete-campaign button is a descendant of the campaign-card button, producing an HTML/hydration warning. Fix by making the card a div[role=button]. Reference: /app/frontend/src/pages/crm/Campaigns.js

action_items: (Carry-over from iter11, low) Fix nested <button> inside campaign-card in /app/frontend/src/pages/crm/Campaigns.js.
(Non-blocking) After deploy, verify /api/register-push returns 201 with the real EMERGENT_PUSH_KEY (500 in preview is expected).
critical_code_review_comments: routes_users.py:_gen_temp_pin uses secrets.choice — cryptographically strong, 6-digit numeric which fits the 4-8 digit validator; good.
routes_users.py create_user surfaces temp_pin + invite_sent in the response ONLY when temp=True — good, prevents accidental disclosure when admin sets an explicit PIN.
routes_auth.change_pin correctly skips current_pin verification when must_change_pin=True, rejects reuse of the same PIN via verify_pin(new_pin), and validates 4-8 digits. Solid.
routes_push.py: single module-level httpx.AsyncClient. Fine, but on FastAPI shutdown it is never explicitly closed — consider a lifespan hook to await _client.aclose(). Not a bug.
routes_push.send_push: chunks recipients in 100s and supports $idempotency_key — good pattern for the SuprSend relay.

mobile app/_layout.tsx: setNotificationChannelAsync + setNotificationHandler are correctly guarded with Platform.OS checks so they no-op on web. Cold-start / warm-tap listeners are wired. No red screen observed in web preview.
mobile src/lib/push.ts: registration is a try/catch-all noop on failure — good, keeps push best-effort and never breaks app boot.

Users.js (web): after creating a user, the modal closes but the list is not optimistically updated — a reload/refetch is required to see the new row (verified via API list). Consider awaiting a re-fetch after successful create to avoid a stale-looking table.

Launcher.js QuickLink data-testid uses label.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z]+/g, '-') — 'My Leads' → 'quick-my-leads'. Locators may have flaked in playwright due to render timing; visually all AM quick actions render. Non-blocking.
